snippet.title: BLOBBELNOPPEL Prologue Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
When his world is flipped around by a cosplaying dictator, Blobithan and his friends Clobbler and Timmy must fight their way out of a town infested by knights and wildlife in order to decide their future.

BLOBBELNOPPEL Prologue Demo launches January 10 on Itch.io and Gamejolt! Store pages are live now

Game development and trailer from Superbad
Guest animation from Rubik (@rub1kdrawz on Instagram)
Game soundtrack and trailer music from @DEFFT612
